name: Greatech Technology Berhad
overview: 2026年，Greatech 宣布通过全资子公司收购位于 Bayan Lepas, Pulau Pinang 的两项工业物业，用于扩大运营设施。其他业务板块在所提供的公告中未见具体动态。
overview_en: In 2026, Greatech announced the acquisition of two industrial properties in Bayan Lepas, Pulau Pinang by its wholly-owned subsidiary to expand its operational facilities. No specific developments were noted for other business segments in the provided announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面宣布收购工业物业以扩大设施。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company announced the acquisition of industrial properties to expand facilities this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 通过全资子公司 Greatech Integration (M) Sdn Bhd 收购位于 Bayan Lepas, Pulau Pinang 的两项工业物业，以扩大运营设施。
actions.text_en: Acquired two industrial properties in Bayan Lepas, Pulau Pinang through wholly-owned subsidiary Greatech Integration (M) Sdn Bhd to expand operational facilities.
